Method of Attack: Toast Overlay Attack using toast notifications to overlay content without needing 'Draw on top' permission
Using Android Accessibility service access to carry out operations and install second malware
Attack Vector: Malicious apps on Google Play Store disguised as Smart AppLocker apps
Toast Overlay Attack to trick users into granting Accessibility service access
Indicators of Compromise: Two apps named Smart AppLocker infected with ToastAmigo removed from Google Play Store
